Title: Python Lambda
Description: A lambda function is a small anonymous function. It can take any number of arguments, but can only have one expression.

Challenges.Title: Create Lambda
Challenges.Exercise: Create a lambda function `x` that adds 10 to the number passed in.

Challenges.Title: Multiple args
Challenges.Exercise: Create lambda `x` that multiplies argument `a` with argument `b`.

Challenges.Title: Inside Function
Challenges.Exercise: Use lambda inside a function `myfunc(n)` returning `lambda a : a * n`.

Challenges.Title: Call Lambda
Challenges.Exercise: Assing the lambda from `myfunc(2)` to `mydoubler` and print `mydoubler(11)`.

Challenges.Title: Advanced Lambda
Challenges.Exercise: Create a lambda `greet` that takes a name and returns 'Hello ' + name.
